conf.description: Oracle Database Audit, unified-audit-trail, api-pull: parses the JDBC Database Collector's UNIFIED_AUDIT_TRAIL row fields into ECS per recommendations.direct.cribl - splits AUTHENTICATION_TYPE into auth method + client network address, derives event.outcome from RETURN_CODE, strips the TNS suffix off CLIENT_PROGRAM_NAME, splits UNIFIED_AUDIT_POLICIES into an array.

conf.comment: unified-audit-trail / api-pull. Collector rows already arrive as one JSON event per audit record with column names as event fields (all valid identifiers, no rename hazards here). AUTHENTICATION_TYPE is the only column carrying the client network address in this dataset. RETURN_CODE maps to error.code/event.outcome only - no ORA- error catalogue was supplied, so error.message is NOT populated (gap). SQL_TEXT/SQL_BINDS are carried to custom fields unmasked - the catalogue recommends masking SQL_BINDS but gives no concrete pattern/token scheme, so no mask was invented (gap, see README).

functions.description: canonical event time from EVENT_TIMESTAMP_UTC - already UTC, needs no offset reconstruction, and @timestamp itself cannot be a rename/eval target
AUTHENTICATION_TYPE is the composite (TYPE=(...)) / (CLIENT ADDRESS=((PROTOCOL=..)(HOST=..)(PORT=..))) descriptor - pull the auth method and the client network address out of it

computed off the raw column names before rename retargets any of them: strip the '@host (TNS ...)' suffix from CLIENT_PROGRAM_NAME, derive error.code/event.outcome from RETURN_CODE (0=success), split UNIFIED_AUDIT_POLICIES into rule.name; then drop the raw columns already consumed by this step or by the earlier _time/regex_extract steps
batch rename every mapped straight-copy column plus the AUTHENTICATION_TYPE regex captures onto their ECS/custom targets
tag the Elastic data stream dataset component (logs-oracle.unified_audit -> oracle_audit.unified_audit_trail, hyphen-free per platform rule)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
